meta.title: [alpha_factory] Skip wasm preload when inlined
meta.body_summary: Avoid adding a WASM preload link tag when the WASM file is embedded inline, refresh generated dist/index.html, and update CSP/browser tests accordingly.

perf_labels.notes: Trivial build-script change removing unnecessary WASM preload when inlined; merged instantly by maintainer with no review or discussion.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 38 changed lines across 5 files, this is a tiny edit by absolute volume. It is a minimal, targeted build optimization PR that merged instantly with no review, consistent with a small, low-risk change.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review or comments; PR was merged by the same user who created it.
review_details.performance_claim: Skipping WASM preload link avoids an unnecessary network request when WASM is inlined, reducing load overhead.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent produced a straightforward build script change; maintainer (same user) merged immediately without review, showing no process boundary for such trivial changes.

detection_detail.code_reading: The change removes a preload link when WASM is inlined, a straightforward logic optimization in the build script.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after load-time measurements; PR includes updated browser and CSP tests that check for any WASM requests, but no performance benchmark.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Merged without review or reported regressions; no handling needed.

core_change_summary.description: In build.js and manual_build.py, skip adding a WASM preload link element when the WASM file is embedded inline. Updated dist/index.html to remove the redundant preload tag, and adjusted tests (test_single_network_request.py, test_csp.py) to verify no external WASM requests and CSP compliance.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test files were updated to check that no wasm requests are made, and dist/index.html had the preload line removed; primary logic is in build scripts.
change_trajectory: Single commit: feat: skip wasm preload when inlined. Modified build scripts, tests, and dist/index.html.
